knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r leaflet_example_ny, fig.path = '../docs/figure/'}
# Tested on R Version 4.4.2 
# leaflet Version 2.2.2
# dplyr Version 1.1.4

# Install and load packages ---------------
packages <- c("leaflet", 
              "dplyr")

# Change to install = TRUE to install the required packages
pacman::p_load(packages, character.only = TRUE, install = FALSE)

# Load an example dataset // Built-in R dataset ---------
# Earthquakes off Fiji
# ?quakes for documentation
data("quakes")

# Clean -------------------------
# Select key variables and sample if desired
quakes_clean <- quakes %>%
  select(lat, long, depth, mag, stations) %>%
  filter(mag >= 4.5)   # focus on larger quakes (more relevant for econ risk)

# Plot Interactive Map ------------------------------
leaflet(quakes_clean) %>%
  addTiles() %>%  # OpenStreetMap base
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~long,
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = ~mag,    # circle size reflects magnitude
    color = "red",
    fillOpacity = 0.5,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Magnitude:</b> ", mag, "<br>",
      "<b>Depth (km):</b> ", depth, "<br>",
      "<b>Stations:</b> ", stations
    )
  )
```

```{r annex, include=TRUE}
## Annex

# Notes for applied researchers / development economists:
# - This interactive map highlights exposure to natural disasters, which can
#   inform work on vulnerability, resilience, infrastructure risk, and 
#   insurance markets.
# - Authors can adapt filtering logic for:
#   (1) High-risk zones (e.g., mag >= 6 or depth < 100 km)
#   (2) Time windows (if combined with temporal datasets)
#   (3) Spatial joins with population / GDP data
# - The quakes dataset is limited to a single region (Fiji), but this code 
#   generalizes to any point dataset with lat/long coordinates.

## Alternative visualization options for authors:
# - Use color to encode depth:
#   addCircleMarkers(color = ~colorNumeric("viridis", depth)(depth))
#
# - Cluster nearby events for a cleaner view:
#   addCircleMarkers(clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions())
#
# - Add multiple base maps:
#   addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") or addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery")
```
